caption:
You know what you spent on ads.

Do you know what it paid you back?

Most owners stop at cost per lead. That number lies on its own. A cheap lead that never closes costs more than an expensive one that does.

The Ad ROI Calculator fixes that. Enter your ad spend, lead count, close rate, and average job value. Get the real return per dollar spent.

Free tool. No signup. No card.
